title: MiniQMT strategy lots never become T+1 sellable after buy fills
description:
Expected: BUY fills synchronized into qmt_strategy.position_lot should become sellable on the next valid A-share trading day. AIstock must update or derive strategy lot available_quantity from open_date/trading calendar/pending sells, so next-day rebalance can generate and submit legal SELL intents subject to broker can_sell and market-state checks.
Actual: QmtStrategyLedgerSyncService creates every BUY PositionLotRecord with available_quantity=0. Code search shows no rollover/settlement path that changes existing lots to available after T+1. QmtManagedOrderService preview/submit uses sum(lot.available_quantity) as the strategy-level sell preflight, so even after BUG-050 generates SELL intents, next-day strategy sells can be blocked forever at the AIstock layer despite MiniQMT broker can_sell being available.
required_verification: Unit test: BUY fill on trade date T creates a lot that is unavailable on T but becomes available on the next valid A-share trading day.
Unit test: weekends/non-trading days do not unlock lots before the next valid trading day.
Unit test: pending SELL intents reduce strategy available sell quantity without changing remaining_quantity until fill.
Integration test: QmtManagedOrderService SELL preview accepts a prior-day strategy lot when MiniQMT broker can_sell is sufficient.
Regression test: same-symbol lots across two strategies unlock independently by strategy_id and are not merged at AIstock strategy level.
closure_requirements: Strategy lot availability is derived or updated from open_date, trading calendar, pending sells, and broker can_sell without manual DB edits.
Next-day rebalance can generate and preflight legal SELL orders for prior-day holdings.
T+1 availability behavior is documented in the qmt_strategy_ledger validation record.
No simplified always-zero or always-available lot fallback remains in the sell preflight path.

events.note: Root cause hypothesis: sync_service.py materializes buy lots with available_quantity=0 and no daily lot availability rollover service exists.

Business impact: P0 because tomorrow or any later rebalance needs to sell prior-day holdings; if strategy-level available_quantity remains zero, AIstock can block all legitimate sells even when miniQMT broker can_sell is positive.

This is separate from BUG-050. BUG-050 covers generating SELL intents for dropped/overweight holdings; this issue covers whether previously bought lots become eligible for those SELL intents under T+1.

Required verification: create a buy lot on T day, run availability rollover or derived-availability check on T+1 trading day, verify SELL preview sees available quantity and non-trading days do not unlock early.

Required verification: same-symbol lots across multiple strategies must unlock independently by strategy lot and pending sells must reduce available quantity without changing remaining quantity until fill.
Expanded from miniQMT issue coverage audit with explicit verification and closure requirements before code fixes.
Mirrored BUG-051 to GitHub issue #54 via gh CLI from miniQMT issue coverage audit.
Confirmed GitHub issue #54 is OPEN and label-synced (bug, status:open, P0, severity:p0, module:qmt_strategy_ledger, risk:trading_sellability_tplus1) before fix worktree creation.
